LanguageData.Mugirl.Migration.LetterText: A small herd of wild Mugirls in bikinis wanders in from the map edge. They seem drawn by the plants here and will stay nearby for a while, constantly lowering their heads to graze, sometimes even chewing on trees. They are gentle; you can try to tame them, and when they have milk you can manually milk them. Once they are full, any Mugirls that are still wild will leave on their own. If you do not want them to keep eating plants, attack any one of them to drive them off; once one is hit, the whole herd will immediately flee the map.
LanguageData.Mugirl.FusionInvestment.LetterText: A suspicious investor has walked in from the map edge. He claims that after long observation of the astonishing conversion rate of grazing Mugirls, he discovered a path toward "bovine fusion technology". Now he wants you to provide startup funding. It sounds deeply unreliable, but the look in his eyes is alarmingly serious. Send a colonist to talk to him and decide whether to invest.
LanguageData.Mugirl.FusionInvestment.TalkOption: Talk to the bovine fusion investor
LanguageData.Mugirl.FusionInvestment.DialogText: The suspicious investor lowers his voice, speaking with the gravity of someone revealing a universal law.\n\n"I have seen the numbers. The rate at which Mugirls convert grass into milk is completely unreasonable. Give me startup capital, and I can push this phenomenon into the bovine fusion stage. Invest now, and when it works, you will have dairy products and experimental relocation slots waiting for you."

LanguageData.Mugirl.FusionInvestment.ResultLetterText: The suspicious investor has sent back an enthusiastic letter. He claims the bovine fusion experiment has achieved a huge success. Nobody can understand the attached charts, but the Mugirl dairy products and relocated Mugirl slaves that arrived with the letter are quite real.

LanguageData.Mugirl.CourierDialogText: The mega corporation courier watches you nervously, one hand never leaving his weapon.\n\n\"I'm just a delivery worker. Do not force me to shoot. I do not want this reaching the company level either.\"

LanguageData.Mugirl.CourierDiary.Title: Courier diary
LanguageData.Mugirl.CourierDiary.Page1:
[Page One]

Welcome to Courier Diary.

This diary records the experiences of a low-level courier during his time working for the mega corporation. It contains practical advice and survival lessons.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CourierDiary.Page2:
[Page Two]

About the mega corporation:

The mega corporation is a vast corporate alliance with armed forces spread across many planets. They field distinctive OPIC and PMC weapon series.

When facing a raid, pay attention to enemy equipment tiers. Enemies carrying PMC-prefix weapons are usually more dangerous.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CourierDiary.Page3:
[Page Three]

About Mugirls:

Mugirls are products of genetic engineering. Their milk has exceptional nutritional value, and Mugirl dairy products can provide additional benefits.

Mugirl milk pudding improves mood, cheese can detoxify, and aged cheese and milk tablets can strengthen immunity.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CourierDiary.Page4:
[Page Four]

About restraint keys:

Crude restraint keys can be made at machining tables or smithies. Fine restraint keys require more advanced workstations.

If you find keys carried by a lucky courier, you can use them to unlock restraints on Mugirls.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CourierDiary.Page5:
[Page Five]

Survival advice:

1. Develop Mugirl husbandry for a stable milk supply
2. Build enough defenses against mega corporation raids
3. Produce dairy foods to strengthen colonists
4. Restraint keys can help recruit enslaved Mugirls

Good luck surviving this brutal world.
LanguageData.Mugirl.LetterWandererJoins: A {PAWN_title} named {PAWN_nameDef} has arrived here, wishing to join the colony.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] claims to have nowhere else to go and is willing to contribute. {PAWN_objective} won't leave voluntarily; you can choose to refuse {PAWN_objective} and send {PAWN_objective} away. However, your colonists will feel uneasy about turning away someone in need.
LanguageData.Mugirl.OpeningPodCrash_MultipleIntro: Transport pods have crashed, carrying multiple escapees.
LanguageData.Mugirl.OpeningPodCrash:
Two transport pods have crash-landed nearby, each carrying an escaped Mugirl slave.
They just escaped from a mega corporation's slave transport ship- whether due to ship malfunction, attack, or some other means remains unknown. The escape has left them utterly exhausted, and the tightly bound slave restraints on their bodies silently record the pain and submission they endured under the mega corporation's tyranny. The impact has also left both of them severely injured.

Now they have nowhere to go. If you choose to rescue them, they will join your colony. Will you give these two pitiful yet lovely escapees a chance at freedom and a new life?
